domain_policy.tabulation: Report provider support separately from validated density intervals.
domain_policy.physical: Locate density segments with finite equilibrium solution, positive chemical-potential/thermodynamic derivatives and 0<=dP/depsilon<=1; keep first crossing bracket and disconnected intervals.
domain_policy.numerical: State derivative scheme, knot/phase treatment and refinement. An acausal upper interval does not reject every lower interval.
domain_policy.calibration: Distinguish nuclear-fit/empirical support from causal domain. Tabulated maximum density is not an empirical validity guarantee.

equations.leptons: n_l(mu)=(mu^2-m_l^2 c^4)^(3/2)/(3 pi^2 (hbar c)^3), mu>=m_l c^2; otherwise0
equations.sound_speed: Along converged neutral beta branch atT=0: cs2/c2=(dP/dn)/(depsilon/dn)=n epsilon''/epsilon', P=n epsilon'-epsilon
equations.composition_derivative: For energy density E(n,x) minimized over independent composition x: d²Eeq/dn²=E_nn-E_nx (E_xx)^(-1) E_xn on a stable smooth interior branch; thresholds and phase changes treated piecewise.
